name: NDW Test Sensor · ESP32-C3
description: Counts button presses. For proving a path end to end.
$comment: chipMatch is tested against what esptool-js reports after connecting, e.g. 'ESP32-C3 (revision v0.4)'. One build targets one chip: the bootloader offset below differs per family, and a mismatched image leaves the board unbootable until it is reflashed.
